# REGISTRY

> Every page of the REGISTRY module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [Participant registry](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry): The Participant registry calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Fetch certificate](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-fetch-certs): Returns a participant's public encryption certificate (PEM X.509 or SPKI key) by participantid; cache it for 24 hours and use it to build the JWE.
- [Fetch certificate path](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-fetch-certs-path): Companion to /fetch/certs: takes the same participantid body and returns a string described as the participant's certificate path.
- [Fetch participants list](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-fetch-participants-list): Payer discovery: lists participants filtered by role, registration date window and optional entity type; the first step of the cashless workflow.
- [Submit the de-link ABHA policies](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-participant-delink-abha-policy): Removes specific products from a member's policy link for a payer, keyed on payerid, memberid and the products listed.
- [Submit the participant details (v2 search)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-participant-details): v2 variant of participant search: takes participant_code and returns the matching full registry records.
- [Get beneficiary policies](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-participant-get-policies): Looks up the policies linked to a beneficiary by ABHA number, member ID or mobile number, returning the payer and product details needed for claims.
- [Get product ID and name](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-participant-getproductidname): Retrieving API described as generating the product ID and product name; declared with a bare string request body and a participant-code response.
- [Link ABHA number to policies](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-participant-link-abha-policy): Payer-side write that links a beneficiary's ABHA number and member ID to one or more products, so provider policy lookups can find them.
- [Submit the participant search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-participant-search): Reads a participant's full registry record by participant_code, including roles, status, encryption_cert and endpoint_URL.
- [Submit the participant update (v1)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-participant-update): Sandbox call. Updates a participant's registry record; participant_code and roles are mandatory, every other field (certificate, endpoint, contacts, status)...
- [Submit the de-link payer product](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-product-delink): Removes a product (product ID and name) from a payer's participant code in the registry.
- [Get product owner](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-product-getowner): Resolves a product ID to the participant code of the payer that owns it.
- [Link payer product](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-product-link): Registers a product (product ID and name) against a payer's participant code, so that it can be referenced in ABHA policy links.
- [Submit the de-link ABHA policies (v2)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-v2-participant-delink-abha-policy): v2 variant of the ABHA policy de-link; same ParticipantDeLinkAbhaRequest body and response as the unversioned call.
- [Get beneficiary policies (v2)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-v2-participant-get-policies): v2 variant of the beneficiary policy lookup; same FetchParticipantPoliciesRequest body and ParticipantListResponse as the unversioned call.
- [Link ABHA number to policies (v2)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-v2-participant-link-abha-policy): v2 variant of the ABHA policy link; same ParticipantLinkAbhaRequest body and ParticipantLinkAbhaResponse as the unversioned call.
- [Initiate ABHA policy link (v2)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-v2-participant-link-abha-policy-init): First half of the two-step v2 link: submits the ABHA policy link request, to be confirmed with a passcode via the validate endpoint.
- [Validate ABHA policy link (v2)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-v2-participant-link-abha-policy-validate): Second half of the two-step v2 link: confirms an initiated ABHA policy link with the passcode and transactionId query parameters.
- [Submit the participant certificate and bridge update (v2)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-v2-participant-update): Production call. Stages a change to a participant encryption certificate and/or endpoint URL; returns a transactionid for passcode confirmation via...
- [Update certificate (v2, no passcode)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-121/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry/endpoints/registry-v2-update-cert): Replaces a participant's public encryption certificate by participantId without passcode validation; the same schema is echoed back on success.
